base.correction: launchWorker's freshClaim drops promptFailures, so the base loop is retire -> relaunch -> three swallowed prompts -> retire (as filed), not one; launchWorker must carry promptRetires or the bound is unreachable

workflowRecommendation: One implementer, Tasks 1-6 in order on this workspace: TDD for Tasks 1-2 (the acceptance-1 test must fail on the base first), docs (3), smoke tooling (4), gates + PR (5), then the smoke-rig run (6) before handing to the tester; the tester re-runs the rig exercise (README section) for the E2E line with the negative control; the reviewer checks the diff-scoped list in the plan.

designContract.stateField: WorkerRoleClaim.promptRetires?: number (interface + zod optional; no state version bump)
designContract.constant: MAX_PROMPT_RETIRES = 2 in worker-admission.ts beside MAX_LAUNCH_FAILURES, judged >=
designContract.verdict: type PromptRetireVerdict = "relaunch" | "died"; recordPromptFailure(token) returns it (undefined = counted only)
designContract.dep: WorkerAdmissionDeps.retireDeadClaim(token, locator, verdict) -> ProcessManager.retirePromptFailedClaim: markWorkerDeadLocked, then on died removeFromQueue + publishWorkerDied unless isTreeGone
designContract.counters: at the threshold: retireDeadClaim first, then promptRetires += 1 and promptFailures = 0 (StopFailed leaves both and the locator untouched); a started turn (commitPromptDelivery, in-bound or late) sets promptFailures = 0 and deletes promptRetires
designContract.logLine: [legion] <token>: retiring after 3 acknowledged prompts with no turn started; relaunch cycle <k> of 2 (console.error, once per retirement, after the stop succeeds)
designContract.terminalClaim: no locator; pendingAssignment kept; promptFailures 0; promptRetires 2; resumeSessionFile = last ompSessionFile; launchFailures absent; token removed from workerAdmission.queue; exactly one worker-died {issue, role} to the tree architect; no worker-queued for that failure; spawn_worker HTTP answer stays queued

callSites.counted: recordPromptFailure (worker-admission.ts:437) is the one decision point; called from queueUnstartedPrompt (:473, used by resumeOrQueueExisting's catch :526-531 = spawn_worker direct prompt, and workerReady's no-turn branch processes.ts:1242-1267 = /worker/ready delivery) and from promoteQueuedWorker's prompt catch (:755-756 = drain's idle-live branch, also refusals)
callSites.publishToSkip: queueUnstartedPrompt's worker-queued (worker-admission.ts:475) when the verdict is died; the drain path publishes nothing on failure
